messages:
carla: Heads-up: production alert — structured-output validation errors spiked on /v1/generate-function for EU cluster since the strict-validator canary rolled out. Dashboard shows ~3.1k rejects in 15m and some customers are hitting quota warnings.

mike: Can you paste the dashboard link and a failure sample? what error class are we seeing?

carla: dashboard: https://console.redwood/internal/dashboards/func-rejects-eu - main tag is 'invalid_tool_shape'. sample logs show the model sometimes returns an array instead of the expected object.

sasha: This sound like the strict validator we enabled yesterday? I remember toggling strict=true for the canary group.

mike: yep — that was the canary for strict-validator v2. Canary traffic was ~12% to model-variant=v2-strict.

deploy-bot: deploy completed: strict-validator v2 to eu-canary at 2026-03-22T22:10Z

tom: We need to be careful — billing currently counts tokens from fallback/degenerate responses too. Customers may be charged for rejected toolcalls.

carla: Quick mitigation proposal: flip strict=false for EU canary (rollback), enable soft-validate sampling, and add a telemetry tag 'validator=soft' on the route so we can separate metrics.

sasha: Agreed. Also we should patch the SDK to include validation_reason in response meta so product apps can decide retry logic instead of blindly hitting fallback.

mike: Minimal patch idea: include a retry_hint in the response meta for cases like 'missing_keys' vs 'wrong_type'. I can open a PR for the server + SDK change.

tom: Longer-term console UX ask: chart rejects should show hard vs soft rejects and annotate deploy toggles. Ops need to correlate spikes to deploy IDs and rollout percentages.

carla: Can we add an alert rule: trigger when reject_rate > 1% AND model_variant != fallback? current alerts only spike when degen usage increases.

sasha: Yes — and scope the alert to route+variant. We'll also set sampling=100% for anomaly detection on those metrics. Also adding a log example to help debugging: 

```
[validator] route=/v1/func model=v2-strict error=invalid_shape returned='[{},{}]' trace=abc123
```

mike: I just pushed a quick console patch that separates 'toolcall' rejects from 'degenerate' fallbacks in the dashboard. should be live in ~10m.

carla: Thanks. After we flip strict back off, we need a safer rollout plan: start strict=true at 1% (canary) and monitor 30m, then 5%, etc. with automatic rollback hooks.

tom: Also update billing rules: do not attribute token billing to responses where validator.rejected=true. finance OK with backfills for the spike window?

sasha: Finance greenlit backfills; we'll need a script to annotate the affected invoices for the spike window.

mike: opened PR #4321 with the rollback + telemetry tagging (server + console). https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4321

carla: :thumbsup: executing rollback now.

deploy-bot: rollback started by carla at 2026-03-22T22:25Z

sasha: Postmortem action items so we don't repeat: [1] sampling config for prod telemetry, [2] SDK exposure of validator meta, [3] console reject-breakdown and deploy annotations, [4] billing rule and invoice backfills. I'll create a ticket board and assign.

mike: Adding test action: expand our function-hook harness to cover arrays vs objects and union edge cases so validator tests catch this.

carla: Thanks all. If reject counts don't drop in 10m ping #eng-oncall.
